topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: Well, if that don’t beat all! Just the other day, I was swapping tales with this chap on the old letter box, and turns out he lives right here, just a stone’s throw from my own cottage! We’ve been cutting the quill over the planting and the reaping, the saints' days and the fairs. Never would have thought it, not in a fortnight of Sundays. Went to the market last week, and there he was, as clear as the sun on a summer's morn. We laughed and slapped backs like old friends, and I must say, it feels right proper to have a neighbor who understands the turn of the soil and the lay of the land. You don’t often find that, not in these parts.
